items.title: Musk says SpaceX-Tesla merger a ‘good idea’ as AI revenue jumps ninefold
items.snippet: A merger would bring Tesla into the same corporate group as Grok developer SpaceXAI and social media platform X.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
